notes: Owner's rule (2026-10-23): from v1.0 (0.5B) on, HeliosLM must score higher than the Taiwanese models. The smallest Taiwanese model known on 2026-10-22 is Breeze 2 3B (TAIDE and Taiwan-LLM start at 7-8B), so it is the gating baseline. 'Higher' = the lower end of the 95% paired-bootstrap interval of (HeliosLM - Breeze 2 3B) per-question accuracy, HeliosLM averaged over the three seeds, is above 0. Every model is scored by the same scorer (tw_bench loglikelihood, zh template, same shots). Qwen3.5-0.8B is a same-size reference, reported but not gated. C-Eval and CMMLU are Simplified-Chinese controls, reported but not gated. Revisions are PENDING until pinned on the pod (the Hub is unreachable from the dev sandbox); the TW-JusticeBench column map must be checked against its files at the same time. Pinning changes the lock; the pinned plan must be committed before #40 training starts.
